overall_reason: Headings and sections wrap and fit every width, but the home page shows no text without script, throws a hydration error on load and pulls a 468 KiB animation runtime for decoration.

score.reason: T-WIDTHS passes apart from the phone header (ROB-007); T-NO-SCRIPT (ROB-015) and T-WEIGHT-FOR-JOB (ROB-018) fail.

findings.title: Content and navigation do not depend on script
findings.evidence: resilience.hidden_content.scripts_off: 0 of 2912 characters visible; the sweep's hidden_content hits record the scripts-off Floor (ROB-001) and 82% of text hidden after load until scrolled. console_errors 3, including 'Minified React error #418' (server HTML does not match the client render), a 401 and an HTTP/2 protocol error.
findings.before: The text is in the HTML but stays invisible until script reveals it, and hydration fails its first match.
findings.after: Render the text visible by default and gate the reveal state on a class that script adds; fix the server and client mismatch behind React error 418.
findings.why: A docs home page meant to send people into the system is blank for anyone whose script fails.

findings.title: Weight fits the page's job
findings.evidence: performance.heaviest: cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@lottiefiles/dotlottie-web@0.81.0/dist/dotlottie-player.wasm at 468 KiB, the only file with known bytes besides one other; 85 requests (warn), 40 script files. The sweep's performance hit (WEB-001) records lab LCP 3100 ms (warn).
findings.before: A WebAssembly animation runtime loads with the home page to play decorative illustrations.
findings.after: Load the Lottie player when an animated illustration scrolls into view, and show a static SVG first.
findings.why: The decoration costs more than the rest of the measured page and the LCP is past the warning.

findings.title: Short labels stay whole on one line
findings.evidence: controls.labels_that_wrap: 'Carbon Design System' on 2 lines in a 165px box at 375; rows_without_room_for_35pct: the header row is 375px with free_px 0 against needed 34.
findings.before: The product name wraps to two lines between the menu button and the search and login actions.
findings.after: Below 400px show 'Carbon' alone, or move login into the menu.
findings.why: The header grows taller on phones and has no room for a longer name or label.

strengths: Large headings and body text wrap at 375 and 1280 (tiles/375-00.png, tiles/1280-03.png), and the document matches every viewport width.
The left navigation collapses into a menu on phones.
IBM Plex is drawn for all text, with no glyph fallback in the first 400 nodes.
